rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses directly related to the scope of practice of veterinary medicine; the board does not pre-approve courses or sponsors. Live interactive webinars count as in-person; practice management max 25% of hours.
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE does not apply until the first full year of licensure; licensed more than one but less than two years: 10 hours before renewal.
rules.carryover: Hours used to make up a delinquent CE requirement may not be applied to the next reporting period.
rules.audit_note: Board may randomly audit up to 50% of renewed licensees; keep proof of completion for one year after the reporting period.
rules.notes: 20 hours within the 24 months before renewal on November 1 of even-numbered years; no more than 10 of the 20 hours online (non-interactive courses). Hardship exemption on request.
